summary: [Web] Work order Services: on a work order with more than 500 assets, adding a service to all of them fails and the whole work order screen is replaced by an error
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
On a big work order (more than 500 assets), a user selects all the assets, opens *Services* and adds a service, for example Cleaning.
The service is not added to any asset. Instead the whole work order screen disappears and only an error line and a *Back to Work Orders* button are left.
This happens because the web app sends all the selected assets in one request, but the server accepts at most 500 assets per request.
It matters because adding a service to every asset is a normal step on large work orders: a customer's 1,512-asset work order hit this on production on 13 Oct.
It should add the service to all the selected assets (sending them in groups of up to 500), and if anything does go wrong, show a short message and keep the work order open.

!ZP-4840-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
After *Add*, the work order page is replaced by "Failed to add service: API call failed: 400 ... at most 500 assets per request ...", with only a *Back to Work Orders* button. No service is added to any asset.

h3. Expected result
The service is added to all the selected assets (the web app sends them in groups of up to 500). If something fails, a short message appears in the dialog or as a toast, and the work order page stays open.

h3. Test data
* Environment: QA https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com
* QA work order used for the proof (QA's own test data, nothing was changed): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/sessions/22a22b9c-4eda-43ed-b131-4b7146912441 ("QA-DEMO ZP-4801 Tuned column (delete me)", site "Android Site 2", *Select all* picks 222 assets)
* To see it end to end you need an OPEN work order with more than 500 assets. QA has none open today (97 open work orders, the largest has 342 assets). The closed work order "AutoTest_WO_85105" on site "test site" has 1,076 assets: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/sessions/90a59769-5998-4847-94a2-af169ffad035. A new work order on "test site" with all its assets is the quickest way to get an open one.
* First seen on production (company Bass Electric, 13 Oct 2026): work order 1029 "D802 - 200 Paul Ave" with 1,512 assets, https://basselectric.egalvanic.ai/sessions/a898ad5e-e3dc-48a5-b0f3-7ab64233c9b7 (screen recording attached: bug_service_bulk.mp4). Please do not repeat *Add* on this customer work order.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager and open a work order that is still open and has more than 500 assets (see Test data).
2. On the *Assets* tab click *Bulk Ops* (the button then reads *Cancel*), tick the checkbox in the table header, then click *Select all <N>*. (Screenshot 1, QA)
!ZP-4840-2-QA-14Oct-bulk-ops-select-all-services.png|width=720!
3. Click *Services*. The "Manage Services - <N> assets" dialog opens. Under *Add a service* choose *Cleaning* and click *Add*. (Screenshot 2, production: 1,512 assets)
!1-manage-services-1512-assets-add-cleaning.png|width=720!
4. The work order screen is replaced by the error and a *Back to Work Orders* button; no service is added. (Screenshot 3, production; Screenshot 4, the same screen on QA today)
!2-failed-to-add-service-at-most-500-assets.png|width=720!
!ZP-4840-3-QA-14Oct-same-error-replaces-work-order-page.png|width=720!
5. Proof of the cause on QA, nothing changed (Screenshot 5): signed in as the Project Manager, QA sent the add request for the QA-DEMO work order above with made-up asset ids and a made-up service id, so nothing can match (re-run on 14 Oct with the same answers):
!ZP-4840-1-PM-QA-add-assets-cap-500-mechanism.png|width=720!
{noformat}
add-assets with 501 asset ids  -> 400 "at most 500 assets per request"
add-assets with 500 asset ids  -> 400 "no addable assets (unknown, deleted, or on another site)"  (control)
{noformat}

h3. Notes for the developer
* The bulk *Manage Services > Add* handler (work order page) sends ALL selected asset ids in ONE {{POST /api/ir_session/<work order id>/add-assets}} call (QA saw all 222 ids in one call); on failure it sets the page-level error, which replaces the whole work order view.
* How Screenshot 4 was made: on the 222-asset QA-DEMO work order QA let the real *Add* request through to the server as 501 made-up asset ids (request size simulated, so nothing could be added). The server's answer and the app's reaction on screen are real.
* The server limit (500 assets per request) is working as designed; the web app does not respect it when *Select all* picks more than 500.
* Removing a service from all assets in the same dialog does NOT hit this limit (it sends one request per asset), but with 1,512 assets that can be 1,512 calls in a row; worth batching in the same fix.

summary: [Web] A customer user can read another company's quotes, including prices, just by knowing that company's site id
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A signed-in customer user (not Egalvanic staff) can read another company's quotes: titles, status and prices.
The app never shows that other company's site to this user, so no screen leads to those quotes.
But if the user sends the quotes request with that company's site id, the server answers with that company's quotes, exactly as it does for the user's own sites.
This matters because one customer can see another customer's commercial information: what was quoted and for how much (three of these quotes are between 113,000 and 121,000).
The server already refuses this same user when they try to open that company's site, so it should refuse the quotes request in the same way.

!ZP-4841-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The quotes request for site "Saveland Avenue Lofts" (another company) answers 200 with that company's 6 quotes: title, status, type, total price and opportunity name. Examples: "EMP for SLD f86052b7..." abandoned, total 116,134.11; "Transformer-Repair" accepted, total 150.00. The same answer also carries each quote's description, scope-of-work, contact and hours fields (empty or short on these 6 quotes).

h3. Expected result
The quotes request is refused (permission denied), the same answer the server already gives this user when they try to open that company's site.

h3. Steps to reproduce

2. Type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities in the address bar. Click *New Quote* and type {{Saveland}} in *Facility*: it says *No options*, because that site belongs to another company. (Control: typing {{Richmond}} lists "Richmond, CA".) (Screenshot 1)

* Same family as ZP-4709 ({{nodes/sld}}, library-designations), but this endpoint is not covered there.

summary: [Web] Creating a quote with a broken site id makes the server fail (internal error) instead of saying 'invalid site' (API only)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
When the create-quote request is sent with a broken site id (not a valid id), the server fails with an internal error instead of a clear "invalid site id" message.
A normal user cannot reach this from the screen: the *New Quote* dialog only lets them pick a real site from a list, so it never sends a broken id.
It matters because a failing server request is noise in the error logs and is not the clean, clear answer the server should give for bad input.
Nothing is created by the request.
It should answer with a clear "invalid site id" message.

!ZP-4842-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The create-quote request with a broken site id ({{not-a-uuid}} or {{12345}}) answers 500 "internal_error" with a trace id. Nothing is created.

h3. Expected result
A clear "invalid site id" answer (400), not an internal error.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (a customer user, not staff)
* Quotes page (type the address; this Project Manager has no Quotes item in the menu, but the page opens): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities
* Reachable only by a request typed in the browser console; nothing was created

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager and type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities in the address bar. In *New Quote* the *Facility* box only offers real sites from the list (typing another company's site name gives "No options"), so the screen cannot send a bad id. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4841-1-PM-14Oct-new-quote-Saveland-no-options-highlighted.png|width=720!
2. Close the dialog, open the browser console (F12) on the same page and run:
{noformat}
fetch('/api/quote/create-standard',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Direct-Write':'true'},body:JSON.stringify({sld_id:'not-a-uuid',title:'QA-DEMO probe (delete me)'})}).then(r=>console.log(r.status))
{noformat}
3. Repeat with {{sld_id:'12345'}}.
4. Both answer 500 "internal_error" with a trace id; nothing is created. (The key screenshot at the top)

h3. Notes for the developer
* API only: the Create Quote dialog only sends a site picked from the list, so no user sees this.
* The same broken-id failure also happens on {{GET /api/opportunity/<id>}} (ZP-4847) and the Bulk Edit endpoints (ZP-4855). Same class as ZP-4820 / ZP-4824 (both READY TO RELEASE).
* One shared id check on incoming site ids would fix all of these at once (answer 400 for a malformed id).

With it OFF, the Admin menu correctly has no *Guests* item, so there is no link to the page.
But an admin user who types the /guests address into the browser still gets the Guests page, with an *Invite guest* button and a search box.

Only admin users can open this page at all; other roles (checked: Project Manager) get "Access Denied", which is fine.

Typing the /guests address opens the *Guests* page with an *Invite guest* button, a search box and an empty table ("No rows").

summary: [Web] SKM import lets a Project Manager add equipment to a site they are not assigned to (only by sending the request directly, not from the screen)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
SKM is the engineering program customers use for power studies. *SKM > Import* on the Assets page loads equipment from an SKM file into the current site.
A Project Manager who is not assigned to a site cannot pick that site in the app, and the server refuses to show them its diagram.
But the two server requests behind the SKM import (check the file, then import it) still accept that site and create new equipment on it.
A normal user cannot do this from the screen, because the site is not offered in the site picker; it takes sending the two requests from the browser console.
It matters because someone with no access to a site can still add equipment to it, and the people who work on that site then find equipment that nobody on the site added.
The import should be refused for a site the user is not assigned to, exactly like the diagram read already is.

!ZP-4849-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The diagram read is refused (422 permission denied), but the import check answers "will create 1" and the import itself answers 200 with "created_nodes: 1". A new bus, "QA-DEMO PM scope test (delete me)", is now on a site this user was never given. On the Assets page it is listed as a Panelboard.

h3. Expected result
Both requests (check and import) are refused with "permission denied" for a site that is not in the user's assigned sites, exactly like the diagram read. Nothing is created.

* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (customer user, not Egalvanic staff, 116 assigned sites; has the data.import permission)

2. Open the *Current site* box and type {{QA-DEMO ZP-4582}}. The app says "No sites available": this site is not assigned to this user. (Screenshot 1)

summary: [Web] SLD Issues list calls an Inverter and a Rectifier a "Transformer" ("no secondary winding voltage"): wrong, confusing wording
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
The one-line diagram (SLD) page has an Issues list that warns about missing engineering data.
For an Inverter and a Rectifier it says "Transformer without secondary voltage" and "This transformer has no secondary winding voltage set".
These assets are not transformers, so the message is confusing: users may think the asset has the wrong class or the check is broken.
The check itself is right: these assets do need a Secondary Voltage, and the user can set it in *Edit Asset*, which clears the warning.
So only the wording is wrong (Low).
The warning should name the real class and say what to fill in, for example "Inverter without output voltage on QA G-Inverter: set Secondary Voltage in Edit Asset". Transformers keep today's text.

!ZP-4882-key-highlighted.png|width=720!
!ZP-4882-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The Issues list shows "Transformer without secondary voltage on QA G-Inverter" (also on QA G-Rectifier, QA INV1 and QA REC1), with the text "This transformer has no secondary winding voltage set…".

h3. Expected result
For inverters and rectifiers the warning uses the real class and the real field name, e.g. "Inverter without output voltage on QA G-Inverter: set Secondary Voltage in Edit Asset" and "Rectifier without output voltage on QA G-Rectifier: …". Transformers keep today's text.

summary: [Web] Asset › Infrared › Add reading: the Technician list offers every user account of the company (246), and 57 of them are shown only as a full email address (outside email domains, egalvanic.com logins, old accounts)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
On an asset's Infrared tab, "Add reading" records a meter reading and asks who the Technician was.
The Technician list offers every user account of the company (246 on Acme QA), not just the people who do field work.
57 of these accounts have no name and are shown only as their full email address, for example electric@spghvac.com, eric@bcesglobal.com, ryanm@hustonelectric.com, and egalvanic.com logins such as techniciansam@egalvanic.com.
Anyone who can add a reading, for example a Project Manager, can scroll through all these addresses.
All 246 accounts belong to Acme's own company. About 22 of them use outside business email domains (such as hustonelectric.com), and most of those are old accounts with no name, role or site.
It matters because email addresses are shown to people who do not need them, and a reading can be saved under a person who could never have taken it.
The list should offer only active people who can do the work on this site, shown by name.

!ZP-4893-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!
!ZP-4893-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

Video (recorded by the QA owner on asset Switchboard-1): [^email_show.mov]

The Technician list shows all 246 company user accounts (plus "None"). 57 of them are shown as their full email address (outside business domains, gmail.com addresses, egalvanic.com logins, test accounts), and any of them can be picked as the technician.

h3. Expected result
* The Technician list offers only people who can do the work: active users with a field / technician role who have access to this asset's site.
